criteria.text: opt-in list query supports bounded limit <=100 and opaque stable cursor ordered by COALESCE(last_activity_at,updated_at,created_at) DESC then id deterministic
concurrent insert/update between pages causes no duplicate IDs and documented snapshot/keyset behavior

search trimmed/case-insensitive across name,lastPreview/project-relevant stored fields and discovers matching root beyond initial100 plus child whose parent doesn't match, returning needed ancestor context
filters scope/category, archived and project id preserved
descendants have explicit bounded continuation per parent rather than silent500 cap
Existing no-pagination request retains exact {sessions,resumable} compatible shape/order/caps
All routes remain inside agentExecutionEnabled/local agent role and current access controls; do not invent hosted Postgres implementation or schema
API contract must document optional pageInfo/child endpoint shape
criteria.reason: Manager reviewed the documented opt-in query/response/consistency/access contract before E20 integration.

criteria.text: Env-gated real HTTP behavioral test passes after the integrated rebuild

api.activation: Presence of limit, cursor, search, or parentId opts into history mode. Otherwise the existing handler and exact {sessions,resumable} response, ordering and caps are unchanged, including scheduledTaskId's legacy20 and tree's legacy500 descendant cap.

query.limit: Integer 1..100, default50. Invalid, duplicate, empty, fractional or >100 is400, not clamped.
query.cursor: Opaque nextCursor; resend the same normalized filters and auth identity. Limit may change. Empty/malformed/unknown/evicted/expired/cross-query cursors return bounded400; discard the cursor and restart.
query.search: Trimmed literal substring, max500 characters, SQLite lower() ASCII case-insensitive matching; percent/underscore are literal. Searches stored session name,last_preview,cwd,task_title,project_id plus referenced project name/cwd across the entire catalog, not the first100. Empty/whitespace search lists roots. Nonempty search includes matching roots and descendants as flat results.
query.scope: chats|scheduled|self_improvement; maps to persisted category. Default chats, or scheduled when scheduledTaskId is supplied. Chats excludes is_system=1. Invalid scope is400 in explicit mode only.
query.projectId: Optional exact project ID; literal null selects unassigned. Composes with scope, archive and search.
query.scheduledTaskId: Optional exact scheduled task ID; nonempty string in explicit mode. Composes with other filters.
query.parentId: Optional nonempty local session ID, max200 characters. Child endpoint is this SAME mounted route with ?parentId=<id>&limit=100; no route/mount changes. Returns only direct children, each with hasChildren. Follow pageInfo.nextCursor with the same parent/filter set; repeat for grandchildren. Missing/inaccessible/filtered-out parent is404.

response.sessions: At most limit flat AgentSession rows plus hasChildren:boolean. No children array in explicit mode; hasChildren is an existence query under the same scope/project/archive/owner filters, not a silent truncated tree.
response.ancestors: Flat deduplicated AgentSession rows plus hasChildren for context of this page's results, linked by parentSessionId. Search match not required, but same scope/project/archive/owner filters apply; stops at missing/filtered-out ancestors or cycles. Context is not a search hit and does not count against limit; may repeat across pages. No descendants are recursively expanded.
response.resumable: Always [] in explicit mode: matching resumable sessions appear in the paged catalog, not a second unbounded/global result set. Legacy resumable unchanged.

api.consistency: Snapshot pagination, NOT OFFSET over mutable SQL rows: first read freezes all matching IDs ordered by COALESCE(last_activity_at,updated_at,created_at) DESC,id DESC. Cursor advances through that frozen ID sequence. Inserts and forward/backward activity changes cannot duplicate or reorder IDs during traversal. Full row contents and eligibility/access are re-read; deleted or no-longer-matching/authorized members disappear, new matches require a fresh query. Context/hasChildren are current reads. Repeat cursor is repeatable for unchanged eligible rows, not a historical row-value snapshot. Snapshot is bound to current DB, normalized filters and owner. In-memory ID-only snapshots expire10 minutes after creation; max32 active snapshots per process with oldest-created eviction. Restart invalidates cursors. No schema, long-lived SQL transaction or hosted implementation.
api.access: Existing agentExecutionEnabled mounting and router authenticateIfPresent(local)/requireAuth(nonlocal) unchanged. Explicit queries additionally honor the existing row-owner rule: an authenticated caller sees only its owner ID or unowned local rows, including results/context/child discovery and every continuation read. Anonymous access is only through the existing local-mode router policy. No new cloud/production surface.
